route_note: Take a fast Gatimaan or Shatabdi express train from New Delhi's Hazrat Nizamuddin or New Delhi station directly to Agra Cantt, then a short auto-rickshaw ride to the Taj Mahal area.
tour_query: Taj Mahal day trip from Delhi

route_note: Take a direct express train from New Delhi or Hazrat Nizamuddin to Jaipur Junction (about 4-5 hours), or a direct AC bus; the main sights are a short taxi from the station.
Frequent local and express trains run from New Delhi and Hazrat Nizamuddin to Mathura Junction in under two hours; Vrindavan is a short auto-rickshaw ride away.
tour_query: Mathura Vrindavan day trip from Delhi

route_note: Take a train or bus toward Alwar/Behror and get off near Neemrana, then a short auto-rickshaw to the fort-palace; alternatively a direct bus or taxi on the Delhi-Jaipur highway.
tour_query: Neemrana Fort day trip from Delhi

route_note: Drive or take a taxi about an hour southwest of Delhi on the Gurugram road to Sultanpur National Park; there is no convenient direct rail link, so a car or bus plus short last leg is needed.
tour_query: Sultanpur bird sanctuary day trip from Delhi
